contact.name: Emily Murray
contact.evidence_quote: Emily Murray ... Emily has had a varied career as a pianist, trumpeter and violinist as an army musician in the Band of the Welsh Guards and as an accompanist and teacher in London. Having returned to the North East, Emily is now Assistant Director of Music at Durham School and regularly performs as a chamber musician, accompanist and solo recitalist.

external_collaboration.evidence_quote: GemArts is an award-winning arts organisation and a nationally recognised leader in the South Asian and diversity arts sector. We’ve worked together for more than 20 years, most notably on the long-running Riverside Ragas series, bringing world-class Indian classical musicians and South Asian artists in folk, jazz and contemporary genres to our stages.
